params.body:
A deck on young people and self-employment, made with Gentells, had to take most of its sources from outside Gentells. This adds the ones Gentells did not know yet as a third source list, read by the same `bin/import-source-list.mjs` as the lists of 20 October and 9 November.

## What is in the list

`research/source-list-2026-11-15.json`, eleven rows, refs GT-M51-01 to GT-M51-11. Every address and feed was opened on 15 November 2026.

Three feeds (type `rss`):

- Securex press room, `press.securex.be/feed` (the barometers appear here; the news page already listed has no feed)
- European Environment Agency newsroom, `eea.europa.eu/en/newsroom/rss.xml`
- European Heat Pump Association, `ehpa.org/feed/`

Eight reference rows (never fetched, never signals):

- RSVZ statistics (Cijfers en tendensen)
- Startersatlas (GraydonCreditsafe, UNIZO, UCM)
- VDAB list of shortage occupations
- TUI Stiftung, Junges Europa
- Eurostat `lfsq_esgaed`, self-employed by age and quarter, with its API address
- Fiverr, Next Gen of Work
- Visa, Gen Alpha study
- OECD and European Commission, The Missing Entrepreneurs

Not in the list because Gentells already holds them as proposals: RetailDetail BE and EU, Securex news, VDAB Trends, the Deloitte Gen Z and Millennial Survey, WEF Future of Jobs, Vinted Newsroom.

## What this does not do

A list proposes. Nothing is read until a person starts a trial, and a reference row gives no signals at all: a figure from it reaches a reader only as a statistic cited at its origin. So after this merge the sources exist in Gentells, and the feeds can start; the series and surveys still need their reading side (#458, #459; the figures are the pull request for #461).

## Tests

`test/source-lifecycle.test.mjs`: the new list adds only rows the first two lists did not hold, three feeds read at their own address, the rest reference, all proposed and inactive. Suite 1694/1694, `tsc` clean.

## On the box after the merge

```bash
node bin/import-source-list.mjs research/source-list-2026-11-15.json            # dry: 11 new (reference 8, rss 3)
node bin/import-source-list.mjs research/source-list-2026-11-15.json --apply
node bin/source-state.mjs trial source-gt-m51-04 source-gt-m51-10 source-gt-m51-11 source-gt-096 source-gt-116 --by=<name>
```

The last line starts the trial of the three new feeds and of RetailDetail BE and EU, which have been proposed since 21 October. Signals from a trial stay off the record until the source is admitted with its terms.

Closes #460
